LESSON: WRITING WRITING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Writing WRITING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Writing WRITING
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: when we are WRITING posture strand, the learner should practising the correct writing posture every writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. practise Writing WRITING
2. use Writing WRITING in clear sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Writing WRITING

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Writing WRITING

Teach
• Focus skill: Writing WRITING.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Writing WRITING.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Writing WRITING
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. when we are WRITING posture strand, the learner should practising the correct writing posture every writing?
2. How do we position a book a) Sit appropriately when • In pairs learners could practise the correct when writing?
3. How do we position hands class. • Learners could recite rhymes on the when writing?
4. Where do you place your activities for writing After adopting the appropriate writing feet while writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
